brewery.name: Tsingtao Brewery Museum
brewery.price_text: ≈ CNY 50–70 adult; check on the day
brewery.hours: Roughly 08:30–17:30 daily; check on the day
brewery.tip: The ticket usually includes a small tasting at the end. Go early to avoid tour groups.

zhanqiao.name: Zhanqiao Pier
zhanqiao.tip: Come at sunrise for calm water and few people. The pier is short, so allow 20–30 minutes.

cathedral.name: St. Michael's Cathedral
cathedral.price_text: ≈ CNY 10 entry; check on the day
cathedral.hours: Daytime hours only; check on the day
cathedral.tip: The square in front is the best photo spot. Many couples take wedding photos here on weekends.

mayfourth.name: May Fourth Square
mayfourth.tip: The red sculpture 'May Wind' is the landmark. Evening brings locals dancing and a sea breeze.

bathing1.name: No. 1 Bathing Beach
bathing1.price_text: Free to enter; showers and lockers cost extra
bathing1.hours: Daytime; swimming season roughly summer only
bathing1.tip: Water is cold outside summer. Check flags and currents before swimming.

badaguan.name: Badaguan Scenic Area walk
badaguan.price_text: Free to walk; some villas charge small entry
badaguan.tip: Quiet leafy streets lined with old villas. Walk from No. 1 Bathing Beach toward Taiping Cape.
badaguan.best: Morning or late afternoon in spring and autumn

taipingcape.name: Taiping Cape viewpoint
taipingcape.tip: A short coastal walk with sea views. Great for sunset photos.

xiaoyushan.name: Xiaoyushan (Little Fish Hill) Park
xiaoyushan.tip: Best quick view over the Old Town red roofs and the sea. Climb takes about 15 minutes.

pichaiyuan.name: Pichaiyuan food street
pichaiyuan.price_text: Pay per stall; snacks ≈ CNY 10–40 each
pichaiyuan.hours: Busy from late morning to evening
pichaiyuan.tip: Try grilled squid and seafood dumplings. Prices are higher than local canteens but it is convenient.

oldtownwalk.name: Old Town lanes walk (Dabaodao area)
oldtownwalk.tip: Wander the steep lanes between the cathedral and the pier. Wear shoes with grip.

beerstreet.name: Qingdao Beer Street
beerstreet.tip: Fresh draft beer is sold in plastic bags to take away. Eat where locals are sitting.

seafoodmarket.name: Tuan岛 seafood market area
seafoodmarket.tip: Buy seafood at the market and ask a nearby restaurant to cook it. Agree the cooking fee first.

laoshan.name: Laoshan Mountain (Taiqing route)
laoshan.price_text: ≈ CNY 80–130 including shuttle; check on the day
laoshan.hours: Daytime; last entry in the afternoon
laoshan.tip: A full half-day trip from the city. Bring water and check the weather before going.

polar.name: Qingdao Polar Ocean World
polar.hours: Daytime; check show times on the day
polar.tip: Popular with families. Check animal show times when you arrive and plan around them.

olympic.name: Olympic Sailing Center waterfront
olympic.tip: Flat waterfront promenade good for an evening stroll. Sailing trips can be booked nearby.

sailing.name: Sailing trip on Fushan Bay
sailing.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–300 per person; check on the day
sailing.tip: Qingdao is China's sailing city. Book a short bay trip and check the cancellation policy for wind.

signalhill.name: Signal Hill Park (Xinhaoshan)
signalhill.tip: Short climb for a wide view over the Old Town and the bay. Good after the cathedral.

naval.name: Chinese Naval Museum
naval.hours: Closed some weekdays; check on the day
naval.tip: Ships and submarines to walk through. Bring ID for entry.

zhongshanroad.name: Zhongshan Road shopping street
zhongshanroad.tip: The main historic shopping street linking the pier and the Old Town. Good for souvenirs.

seafooddinner.name: Seafood dinner near May Fourth Square
seafooddinner.tip: Ask for prices by weight before ordering crab or shellfish. Clams and squid are cheaper.
